Text: A whoreson beetle-headed, flap-ear'd knave! Come, Kate, sit down; I know you have a stomach. Will you give thanks, sweet Kate; or else shall I? What's this? mutton?
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: So shalt thou show me friendship. Take thou that: Live, and be prosperous: and farewell, good fellow.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: At what hour to-morrow Shall I attend your lordship?
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: O, find him! give this ring to my true knight, And bid him come to take his last farewell.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: No, sir; but hear I do that he hath two, The one as famous for a scolding tongue As is the other for beauteous modesty.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: Well, I must do't: Away, my disposition, and possess me Some harlot's spirit! my throat of war be turn'd, Which quired with my drum, into a pipe Small as an eunuch, or the virgin voice That babies lulls asleep! the smiles of knaves Tent in my cheeks, and schoolboys' tears take up The glasses of my sight! a beggar's tongue Make motion through my lips, and my arm'd knees, Who bow'd but in my stirrup, bend like his That hath received an alms! I will not do't, Lest I surcease to honour mine own truth And by my body's action teach my mind A most inherent baseness.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Why, our battalion trebles that account: Besides, the king's name is a tower of strength, Which they upon the adverse party want. Up with my tent there! Valiant gentlemen, Let us survey the vantage of the field Call for some men of sound direction Let's want no discipline, make no delay, For, lords, to-morrow is a busy day.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Who knows the lord protector's mind herein? Who is most inward with the royal duke?
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: Mine, full of sorrow and heart's discontent.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Why came I hither but to that intent? Think you a little din can daunt mine ears? Have I not in my time heard lions roar? Have I not heard the sea puff'd up with winds Rage like an angry boar chafed with sweat? Have I not heard great ordnance in the field, And heaven's artillery thunder in the skies? Have I not in a pitched battle heard Loud 'larums, neighing steeds, and trumpets' clang? And do you tell me of a woman's tongue, That gives not half so great a blow to hear As will a chestnut in a farmer's fire? Tush, tush! fear boys with bugs.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Long live King Henry! Plantagenet embrace him.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: It is determined, not concluded yet: But so it must be, if the king miscarry.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Go to; I say you shall.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Intended or committed was this fault? If on the first, how heinous e'er it be, To win thy after-love I pardon thee.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: A gentleman, nurse, that loves to hear himself talk, and will speak more in a minute than he will stand to in a month.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Yea, brother of Clarence, are thou here too? Nay, then I see that Edward needs must down. Yet, Warwick, in despite of all mischance, Of thee thyself and all thy complices,
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Bring forth these men. Bushy and Green, I will not vex your souls-- Since presently your souls must part your bodies-- With too much urging your pernicious lives, For 'twere no charity; yet, to wash your blood From off my hands, here in the view of men I will unfold some causes of your deaths. You have misled a prince, a royal king, A happy gentleman in blood and lineaments,
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: Bliss and goodness on you!
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: How now, my masters! have you chose this man?
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Meet on the market-place. We'll attend you there: Where, if you bring not Marcius, we'll proceed In our first way.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: What if both Lewis and Warwick be appeased By such invention as I can devise?
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Faith, he is gone unto the taming-school.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: But didst thou see them dead?
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Good even. Friar, where's the provost?
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: I do owe them still My life and services.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Be patient, they are friends, Ratcliff and Lovel.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: I will not fail: 'tis twenty years till then. I have forgot why I did call thee back.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Down, down I come; like glistering Phaethon, Wanting the manage of unruly jades. In the base court? Base court, where kings grow base, To come at traitors' calls and do them grace. In the base court? Come down? Down, court! down, king! For night-owls shriek where mounting larks should sing.
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Come, what talk you Of Marcius?
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Mount you, my lord; towards Berwick post amain: Edward and Richard, like a brace of greyhounds Having the fearful flying hare in sight, With fiery eyes sparkling for very wrath, And bloody steel grasp'd in their ireful hands, Are at our backs; and therefore hence amain.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Else let my brother die, If not a feodary, but only he Owe and succeed thy weakness.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Now, brother of Clarence, how like you our choice, That you stand pensive, as half malcontent?
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: What less than dooms-day is the prince's doom?
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: To the Capitol, come: We will be there before the stream o' the people; And this shall seem, as partly 'tis, their own, Which we have goaded onward.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Tell him, my mourning weeds are laid aside, And I am ready to put armour on.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Then never man was true.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: My Lord Northumberland, see them dispatch'd. Uncle, you say the queen is at your house; For God's sake, fairly let her be entreated: Tell her I send to her my kind commends; Take special care my greetings be deliver'd.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: Nay, stay; lets hear the orisons he makes.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: I tell thee, Kate, 'twas burnt and dried away; And I expressly am forbid to touch it, For it engenders choler, planteth anger; And better 'twere that both of us did fast, Since, of ourselves, ourselves are choleric, Than feed it with such over-roasted flesh. Be patient; to-morrow 't shall be mended, And, for this night, we'll fast for company: Come, I will bring thee to thy bridal chamber.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Nay, come, Kate, come; you must not look so sour.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Alas, poor Clarence! is it for a wife That thou art malcontent? I will provide thee.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: I know it, uncle, and oppose not myself Against their will. But who comes here? Welcome, Harry: what, will not this castle yield?
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: No doubt, no doubt; O, 'tis a parlous boy; Bold, quick, ingenious, forward, capable He is all the mother's, from the top to toe.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: To brag unto them, thus I did, and thus; Show them the unaching scars which I should hide, As if I had received them for the hire Of their breath only!
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: One word more, one word. This tiger-footed rage, when it shall find The harm of unscann'd swiftness, will too late Tie leaden pounds to's heels. Proceed by process; Lest parties, as he is beloved, break out, And sack great Rome with Romans.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Have done thy charm, thou hateful wither'd hag!
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Scratches with briers, Scars to move laughter only.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Then know, it is your fault that you resign The supreme seat, the throne majestical, The scepter'd office of your ancestors, Your state of fortune and your due of birth, The lineal glory of your royal house,
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: By such despair, I should accuse myself.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Not proud, you have; but thankful, that you have: Proud can I never be of what I hate; But thankful even for hate, that is meant love.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: You wrong me, Signior Gremio: give me leave. I am a gentleman of Verona, sir, That, hearing of her beauty and her wit, Her affability and bashful modesty, Her wondrous qualities and mild behavior, Am bold to show myself a forward guest Within your house, to make mine eye the witness Of that report which I so oft have heard. And, for an entrance to my entertainment, I do present you with a man of mine, Cunning in music and the mathematics, To instruct her fully in those sciences,
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Never came poison from so sweet a place.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: What is the matter, uncle? speak; Recover breath; tell us how near is danger, That we may arm us to encounter it.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: What comfort, man? how is't with aged Gaunt?
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Nay, not as one would say, healthy; but so sound as things that are hollow: thy bones are hollow; impiety has made a feast of thee.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: He loves your people But tie him not to be their bedfellow. Worthy Cominius, speak. Nay, keep your place.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: But that a joy past joy calls out on me, It were a grief, so brief to part with thee: Farewell.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: My gracious uncle, let me know my fault: On what condition stands it and wherein?
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: You peasant swain! you whoreson malt-horse drudge! Did I not bid thee meet me in the park, And bring along these rascal knaves with thee?
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: She hath, and in that sparing makes huge waste, For beauty starved with her severity Cuts beauty off from all posterity. She is too fair, too wise, wisely too fair,
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: See you yond coign o' the Capitol, yond corner-stone?
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Spoke like an officer; ha' to thee, lad!
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Come on, i' God's name; once more toward our father's. Good Lord, how bright and goodly shines the moon!
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Now, by Saint Peter's Church and Peter too, He shall not make me there a joyful bride. I wonder at this haste; that I must wed Ere he, that should be husband, comes to woo. I pray you, tell my lord and father, madam, I will not marry yet; and, when I do, I swear, It shall be Romeo, whom you know I hate, Rather than Paris. These are news indeed!
Speaker: JULIET

Text: I thank you for this comfort. Fare you well, good father.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Ah, who is nigh? come to me, friend or foe, And tell me who is victor, York or Warwick? Why ask I that? my mangled body shows, My blood, my want of strength, my sick heart shows. That I must yield my body to the earth And, by my fall, the conquest to my foe. Thus yields the cedar to the axe's edge, Whose arms gave shelter to the princely eagle, Under whose shade the ramping lion slept, Whose top-branch overpeer'd Jove's spreading tree And kept low shrubs from winter's powerful wind. These eyes, that now are dimm'd with death's black veil, Have been as piercing as the mid-day sun,
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: I thought all for the best.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: If, by the tribunes' leave, and yours, good people, I may be heard, I would crave a word or two; The which shall turn you to no further harm Than so much loss of time.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Nay, if the devil have given thee proofs for sin, Thou wilt prove his. Take him to prison, officer: Correction and instruction must both work Ere this rude beast will profit.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Amen, amen! but come what sorrow can, It cannot countervail the exchange of joy
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Then, gentle Clarence, welcome unto Warwick; And welcome, Somerset: I hold it cowardice To rest mistrustful where a noble heart Hath pawn'd an open hand in sign of love; Else might I think that Clarence, Edward's brother,
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: By nothing; for this is no oath: The George, profaned, hath lost his holy honour; The garter, blemish'd, pawn'd his knightly virtue; The crown, usurp'd, disgraced his kingly glory. if something thou wilt swear to be believed, Swear then by something that thou hast not wrong'd.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: And tells us, what occasion of import Hath all so long detain'd you from your wife, And sent you hither so unlike yourself?
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: I'll see what I can do.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: I will go wash; And when my face is fair, you shall perceive Whether I blush or no: howbeit, I thank you. I mean to stride your steed, and at all times To undercrest your good addition To the fairness of my power.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Madam, I am here. What is your will?
Speaker: JULIET

Text: How came it that the absent duke had not either delivered him to his liberty or executed him? I have heard it was ever his manner to do so.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: To whom should I complain? Did I tell this, Who would believe me? O perilous mouths, That bear in them one and the self-same tongue, Either of condemnation or approof;
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Mine, such as fill my heart with unhoped joys.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Relate your wrongs; in what? by whom? be brief.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Is not a dukedom, sir, a goodly gift?
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Forbear to sleep the nights, and fast the days; Compare dead happiness with living woe; Think that thy babes were fairer than they were,
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Why, this was known before.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: I stretch it out for that word 'broad;' which added to the goose, proves thee far and wide a broad goose.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: This is a happier and more comely time Than when these fellows ran about the streets, Crying confusion.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: We are all undone, unless The noble man have mercy.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: I do beseech you, Let me o'erleap that custom, for I cannot Put on the gown, stand naked and entreat them, For my wounds' sake, to give their suffrage: please you That I may pass this doing.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Ha' not you seen, Camillo,-- But that's past doubt, you have, or your eye-glass Is thicker than a cuckold's horn,--or heard,-- For to a vision so apparent rumour Cannot be mute,--or thought,--for cogitation Resides not in that man that does not think,-- My wife is slippery? If thou wilt confess, Or else be impudently negative, To have nor eyes nor ears nor thought, then say My wife's a hobby-horse, deserves a name As rank as any flax-wench that puts to Before her troth-plight: say't and justify't.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: I know you can do very little alone; for your helps are many, or else your actions would grow wondrous single: your abilities are too infant-like for doing much alone. You talk of pride: O that you could turn your eyes toward the napes of your necks, and make but an interior survey of your good selves! O that you could!
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: As now she might have done, So much to my good comfort, as it is Now piercing to my soul. O, thus she stood, Even with such life of majesty, warm life, As now it coldly stands, when first I woo'd her! I am ashamed: does not the stone rebuke me For being more stone than it? O royal piece, There's magic in thy majesty, which has My evils conjured to remembrance and From thy admiring daughter took the spirits, Standing like stone with thee.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: Ay, nurse; what of that? both with an R.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Brother of Gloucester, at Saint Alban's field This lady's husband, Sir Richard Grey, was slain,
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Mine innocency and Saint George to thrive!
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: And to that end we wish'd your lord-ship here, To avoid the carping censures of the world.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Then go with me to make the matter good. This, by the way, I let you understand; my father is here look'd for every day, To pass assurance of a dower in marriage
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: Slandering a prince deserves it. She, Claudio, that you wrong'd, look you restore. Joy to you, Mariana! Love her, Angelo: I have confess'd her and I know her virtue. Thanks, good friend Escalus, for thy much goodness: There's more behind that is more gratulate. Thanks, provost, for thy care and secrecy: We shill employ thee in a worthier place. Forgive him, Angelo, that brought you home
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: You common cry of curs! whose breath I hate As reek o' the rotten fens, whose loves I prize As the dead carcasses of unburied men That do corrupt my air, I banish you; And here remain with your uncertainty! Let every feeble rumour shake your hearts! Your enemies, with nodding of their plumes, Fan you into despair! Have the power still To banish your defenders; till at length Your ignorance, which finds not till it feels, Making not reservation of yourselves, Still your own foes, deliver you as most Abated captives to some nation That won you without blows! Despising, For you, the city, thus I turn my back: There is a world elsewhere.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Now put it, God, in the physician's mind To help him to his grave immediately! The lining of his coffers shall make coats To deck our soldiers for these Irish wars. Come, gentlemen, let's all go visit him: Pray God we may make haste, and come too late!
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: I would they were, that I might die at once; For now they kill me with a living death. Those eyes of thine from mine have drawn salt tears,
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Very well met, and well come. What is the news from this good deputy?
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Thou speak'st truth. No more such wives; therefore, no wife: one worse, And better used, would make her sainted spirit Again possess her corpse, and on this stage, Where we're offenders now, appear soul-vex'd, And begin, 'Why to me?'
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: To-morrow, then, we will attend your grace: And so most joyfully we take our leave.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: Stay, yet look back with me unto the Tower. Pity, you ancient stones, those tender babes Whom envy hath immured within your walls! Rough cradle for such little pretty ones! Rude ragged nurse, old sullen playfellow For tender princes, use my babies well! So foolish sorrow bids your stones farewell.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: How doth my dear morsel, thy mistress? Procures she still, ha?
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: You know neither me, yourselves nor any thing. You are ambitious for poor knaves' caps and legs: you wear out a good wholesome forenoon in hearing a cause between an orange wife and a fosset-seller; and then rejourn the controversy of three pence to a second day of audience. When you are hearing a matter between party and party, if you chance to be pinched with the colic, you make faces like mummers; set up the bloody flag against all patience; and, in roaring for a chamber-pot, dismiss the controversy bleeding the more entangled by your hearing: all the peace you make in their cause is, calling both the parties knaves. You are a pair of strange ones.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Not so well apparell'd As I wish you were.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: This is the fruit of rashness! Mark'd you not How that the guilty kindred of the queen Look'd pale when they did hear of Clarence' death? O, they did urge it still unto the king! God will revenge it. But come, let us in, To comfort Edward with our company.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: What, doth she swoon? use means for her recovery.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: By the apostle Paul, shadows to-night Have struck more terror to the soul of Richard Than can the substance of ten thousand soldiers Armed in proof, and led by shallow Richmond. It is not yet near day. Come, go with me; Under our tents I'll play the eaves-dropper, To see if any mean to shrink from me.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Old John of Gaunt, time-honour'd Lancaster, Hast thou, according to thy oath and band, Brought hither Henry Hereford thy bold son, Here to make good the boisterous late appeal, Which then our leisure would not let us hear, Against the Duke of Norfolk, Thomas Mowbray?
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Madam, we did: he desires to make atonement Betwixt the Duke of Gloucester and your brothers, And betwixt them and my lord chamberlain; And sent to warn them to his royal presence.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: No, not a whit: I find you passing gentle. 'Twas told me you were rough and coy and sullen, And now I find report a very liar; For thou are pleasant, gamesome, passing courteous, But slow in speech, yet sweet as spring-time flowers: Thou canst not frown, thou canst not look askance, Nor bite the lip, as angry wenches will, Nor hast thou pleasure to be cross in talk, But thou with mildness entertain'st thy wooers, With gentle conference, soft and affable. Why does the world report that Kate doth limp? O slanderous world! Kate like the hazel-twig Is straight and slender and as brown in hue As hazel nuts and sweeter than the kernels. O, let me see thee walk: thou dost not halt.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Ely with Richmond troubles me more near Than Buckingham and his rash-levied army. Come, I have heard that fearful commenting Is leaden servitor to dull delay; Delay leads impotent and snail-paced beggary Then fiery expedition be my wing, Jove's Mercury, and herald for a king! Come, muster men: my counsel is my shield; We must be brief when traitors brave the field.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: You speak as if that I had slain my cousins.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Sir, I shall tell you. With a kind of smile, Which ne'er came from the lungs, but even thus-- For, look you, I may make the belly smile As well as speak--it tauntingly replied To the discontented members, the mutinous parts That envied his receipt; even so most fitly As you malign our senators for that They are not such as you.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: No, sir: yet oft, When blows have made me stay, I fled from words. You soothed not, therefore hurt not: but your people, I love them as they weigh.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Let him thank me, that holp to send him thither; For he was fitter for that place than earth.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Why 'her unhappy brother'? let me ask, The rather for I now must make you know I am that Isabella and his sister.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Well, your imprisonment shall not be long; Meantime, have patience.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: And brief, good mother; for I am in haste.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: We were not born to sue, but to command; Which since we cannot do to make you friends, Be ready, as your lives shall answer it, At Coventry, upon Saint Lambert's day: There shall your swords and lances arbitrate
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Nature teaches beasts to know their friends.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: May I change these garments?
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Do you so, sir? And was the duke a fleshmonger, a fool, and a coward, as you then reported him to be?
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: Why, then, though loath, yet must I be content: We'll yoke together, like a double shadow To Henry's body, and supply his place; I mean, in bearing weight of government, While he enjoys the honour and his ease. And, Clarence, now then it is more than needful Forthwith that Edward be pronounced a traitor, And all his lands and goods be confiscate.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Ay, to the proof; as mountains are for winds, That shake not, though they blow perpetually.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: O, I am fortune's fool!
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: What, Warwick, wilt thou leave the town and fight? Or shall we beat the stones about thine ears?
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: For that, being one o' the lowest, basest, poorest, Of this most wise rebellion, thou go'st foremost: Thou rascal, that art worst in blood to run, Lead'st first to win some vantage.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Ay, as the glasses where they view themselves; Which are as easy broke as they make forms. Women! Help Heaven! men their creation mar In profiting by them. Nay, call us ten times frail; For we are soft as our complexions are, And credulous to false prints.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Out, devil! I remember them too well: Thou slewest my husband Henry in the Tower, And Edward, my poor son, at Tewksbury.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Why, how now, Claudio! whence comes this restraint?
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: Fear not, my lord, I'll play the orator As if the golden fee for which I plead Were for myself: and so, my lord, adieu.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: Be eloquent in my behalf to her.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: O God, I have an ill-divining soul! Methinks I see thee, now thou art below,
Speaker: JULIET

Text: O villains, vipers, damn'd without redemption! Dogs, easily won to fawn on any man! Snakes, in my heart-blood warm'd, that sting my heart! Three Judases, each one thrice worse than Judas! Would they make peace? terrible hell make war Upon their spotted souls for this offence!
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Did you such a thing?
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Where is thy power, then, to beat him back? Where are thy tenants and thy followers? Are they not now upon the western shore. Safe-conducting the rebels from their ships!
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Let them lay by their helmets and their spears,
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Oh, he is young and his minority Is put unto the trust of Richard Gloucester, A man that loves not me, nor none of you.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: A hundred, if they'll do you any good. Is lechery so look'd after?
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: What man art thou that thus bescreen'd in night So stumblest on my counsel?
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Here. Why dost thou spit at me?
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: 'Twas I that gave the kingdom to thy brother.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: I know so. But, gentle Lady Anne, To leave this keen encounter of our wits, And fall somewhat into a slower method, Is not the causer of the timeless deaths Of these Plantagenets, Henry and Edward, As blameful as the executioner?
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Go, go, up to the leads; the lord mayor knocks. Welcome my lord; I dance attendance here; I think the duke will not be spoke withal. Here comes his servant: how now, Catesby, What says he?
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: O, let us hence; I stand on sudden haste.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Tush, man, abodements must not now affright us: By fair or foul means we must enter in, For hither will our friends repair to us.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Ay, if yourself's remembrance wrong yourself.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: And you, good brother father. What offence hath this man made you, sir?
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Why, so! then am I sure of victory. Now therefore let us hence; and lose no hour, Till we meet Warwick with his foreign power. 3 KING HENRY VI
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: You have made Good work, you and your cry! Shall's to the Capitol?
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Now, you companion, I'll say an errand for you: You shall know now that I am in estimation; you shall perceive that a Jack guardant cannot office me from my son Coriolanus: guess, but by my entertainment with him, if thou standest not i' the state of hanging, or of some death more long in spectatorship, and crueller in suffering; behold now presently, and swoon for what's to come upon thee. The glorious gods sit in hourly synod about thy particular prosperity, and love thee no worse than thy old father Menenius does! O my son, my son! thou art preparing fire for us; look thee, here's water to quench it. I was hardly moved to come to thee; but being assured none but myself could move thee, I have been blown out of your gates with sighs; and conjure thee to pardon Rome, and thy petitionary countrymen. The good gods assuage thy wrath, and turn the dregs of it upon this varlet here,--this, who, like a block, hath denied my access to thee.

Text: You are too senseless--obstinate, my lord, Too ceremonious and traditional Weigh it but with the grossness of this age, You break not sanctuary in seizing him. The benefit thereof is always granted To those whose dealings have deserved the place,
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: Come, come, you mock me; this is not the way To win our daughter.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: I know't too well. Give me the boy: I am glad you did not nurse him: Though he does bear some signs of me, yet you Have too much blood in him.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: Gentlemen, God save you. If I may be bold, Tell me, I beseech you, which is the readiest way To the house of Signior Baptista Minola?
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: I think so. Kill'd! She I kill'd! I did so: but thou strikest me Sorely, to say I did; it is as bitter Upon thy tongue as in my thought: now, good now, Say so but seldom.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: Bid them all home; he's gone, and we'll no further. The nobility are vex'd, whom we see have sided In his behalf.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Why, this was moulded on a porringer; A velvet dish: fie, fie! 'tis lewd and filthy: Why, 'tis a cockle or a walnut-shell, A knack, a toy, a trick, a baby's cap: Away with it! come, let me have a bigger.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: How now, fair lords! What fare? what news abroad?
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Go do it instantly. And you, my noble and well-warranted cousin, Whom it concerns to hear this matter forth, Do with your injuries as seems you best, In any chastisement: I for a while will leave you; But stir not you till you have well determined Upon these slanderers.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Go play, Mamillius; thou'rt an honest man. Camillo, this great sir will yet stay longer.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: Well, then, no more but this: go, gentle Catesby, And, as it were far off sound thou Lord Hastings, How doth he stand affected to our purpose; And summon him to-morrow to the Tower, To sit about the coronation. If thou dost find him tractable to us, Encourage him, and show him all our reasons: If he be leaden, icy-cold, unwilling, Be thou so too; and so break off your talk,
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: Was he met there? his train? Camillo with him?
Speaker: LEONTES

Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Nay, pray, be patient: if you refuse your aid In this so never-needed help, yet do not Upbraid's with our distress. But, sure, if you Would be your country's pleader, your good tongue, More than the instant army we can make, Might stop our countryman.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: No matter where; of comfort no man speak: Let's talk of graves, of worms, and epitaphs; Make dust our paper and with rainy eyes Write sorrow on the bosom of the earth,

Text: It is; you lie, you lie: I say thou liest, Camillo, and I hate thee, Pronounce thee a gross lout, a mindless slave, Or else a hovering temporizer, that Canst with thine eyes at once see good and evil, Inclining to them both: were my wife's liver Infected as her life, she would not live The running of one glass.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: Tedious it were to tell, and harsh to hear: Sufficeth I am come to keep my word, Though in some part enforced to digress; Which, at more leisure, I will so excuse As you shall well be satisfied withal. But where is Kate? I stay too long from her: The morning wears, 'tis time we were at church.

Text: O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon, That monthly changes in her circled orb, Lest that thy love prove likewise variable.

Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Speaker: JULIET

Text: You cavil, widow: I did mean, my queen.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: No, holy father; throw away that thought; Believe not that the dribbling dart of love Can pierce a complete bosom. Why I desire thee To give me secret harbour, hath a purpose More grave and wrinkled than the aims and ends Of burning youth.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Those gracious words revive my drooping thoughts And give my tongue-tied sorrows leave to speak. Now, therefore, be it known to noble Lewis, That Henry, sole possessor of my love, Is of a king become a banish'd man, And forced to live in Scotland a forlorn; While proud ambitious Edward Duke of York Usurps the regal title and the seat Of England's true-anointed lawful king. This is the cause that I, poor Margaret, With this my son, Prince Edward, Henry's heir, Am come to crave thy just and lawful aid; And if thou fail us, all our hope is done: Scotland hath will to help, but cannot help; Our people and our peers are both misled, Our treasures seized, our soldiers put to flight, And, as thou seest, ourselves in heavy plight.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: I would thou hadst done so by Claudio. Go fetch him hither; let me look upon him.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Hail to you, provost! so I think you are.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: This shall assure my constant loyalty, That if our queen and this young prince agree, I'll join mine eldest daughter and my joy To him forthwith in holy wedlock bands.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: By so much is the wonder in extremes.

Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: The king! why, who's that?

Text: Here, Hastings; I will never more remember Our former hatred, so thrive I and mine!
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: The blessed gods Purge all infection from our air whilst you Do climate here! You have a holy father, A graceful gentleman; against whose person, So sacred as it is, I have done sin: For which the heavens, taking angry note, Have left me issueless; and your father's blest, As he from heaven merits it, with you Worthy his goodness. What might I have been, Might I a son and daughter now have look'd on, Such goodly things as you!
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: Which she shall purchase with still lasting war.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: But shall you on your knowledge find this way?
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: I must indeed; and therefore came I hither. Good gentle youth, tempt not a desperate man; Fly hence, and leave me: think upon these gone; Let them affright thee. I beseech thee, youth, Put not another sin upon my head, By urging me to fury: O, be gone! By heaven, I love thee better than myself;
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Then in plain terms tell her my loving tale.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Go take her hence, and marry her instantly. Do you the office, friar; which consummate, Return him here again. Go with him, provost.
